prompt.title: 受击 · 后仰回站（hit）
prompt.rule: SHAPE OF THE REACTION. The clip starts on his ordinary standing pose, then he is hit and snaps backwards - the head jerks back, the chin comes up, the shoulders hunch and the arms fly up and back - he holds that for a moment at the extreme of the reaction, and then he settles back down and finishes on exactly the standing pose the clip started on.

TIMING. The snap is fast - two or three frames from standing to the extreme - and the settle afterwards is slow, using the rest of the clip. He must not bounce back and forth and must not keep wobbling after he has settled.

ONE STEP BACK. He takes one short step backwards with one foot as he is knocked back, and that is the only travel in the clip: he does not slide, does not run backwards and never leaves the frame. His head stays inside the safe margin at the extreme of the reaction - the pose is compressed backwards, not enlarged.
HIT WITHOUT EFFECTS. The blow itself is not drawn: no attacker, no weapon, no impact star, no flash, no screen shake, no speed lines and no blood. Only his body reacts.
CLOSES. The last frame is the same pose as the first frame, so the clip returns to idle cleanly.
